## About Me

<img src="https://media1.tenor.com/m/MYL0JUb9bYMAAAAd/adventure-time-gunter.gif" align="right" width="280" />

AI, data and backend engineer from São José dos Pinhais, PR, Brazil.

I build **LLM agents**, **document and data pipelines** and the **backend services** that keep them running in production.

- **Now:** LangGraph agents, MCP servers and queue-driven pipelines that turn legal documents into structured data
- **Focus:** agent orchestration, retrieval, data modeling and LLM cost control
- **Education:** Systems Analysis and Development @ Senac PR
- 🏆 1st place, Ideathon Inova Comércio (Sebrae/PR + Senac/PR, 2025)
